summary: BMO 2025-5C10 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K solely to report the termination of Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the Newport on the Levee mortgage loan under the BMO 2024-5C8 PSA, with CWCapital Asset Management LLC appointed as successor special servicer effective July 29, 2026. This is a routine servicing administration update under Item 8.01, not a special situation. No securities transaction, strategic event, or corporate action is involved; the filing merely discloses a servicing arrangement change and attaches the related acknowledgment. There is no deal-arb angle or securityholder action required.
